description.en: Unstyled, accessible UI components for building high-quality design systems.
description.zh: 开源无样式底层 React 组件库，专为构建高质量设计系统与无障碍界面而设计。

content.en: Radix Primitives is an open-source UI component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps. Maintained by WorkOS, it provides unstyled, low-level components with robust keyboard navigation, focus management, screen reader support, and fully composable APIs that integrate seamlessly with any styling solution.
content.zh: Radix Primitives 是目前应用最广泛的底层无样式 React 组件体系之一，现由 WorkOS 维护。它专注解决复杂 UI 组件中最棘手的交互与无障碍难题（包括键盘导航循环、焦点陷阱捕获、屏幕阅读器适配等），其组件呈乐高积木式高度可组合，能够无缝契合任何 CSS 方案。
